name: Location Tracker
description: Locates agents (laptops by default, but can be enabled for any device) and shows the location as a widget right on the client, plus a map with history. Sources, in order: operating-system location, Wi-Fi BSSID (Google Geolocation API), IP geolocation. Interval and retention are configurable. Location data is sensitive: visible only with permission, tracking can be turned off per device.
author: BYTERA

settings.help: Which sources to use, best first: os (operating system), wifi (Wi-Fi BSSID via Google), ip (IP geolocation).
